statement.zh: Lal 等《Excavations at Kalibangan: The Early Harappans》(MASI 98, 2003) 正式报告 1960–1969 早期哈拉帕层，含犁耕田垄讨论。
statement.en: Lal et al. Excavations at Kalibangan: The Early Harappans (MASI 98, 2003) formally reports 1960–1969 Early Harappan levels, including the plowed-field discussion.
